items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bill Russell in the context of Freddie Keppard's brother, but the interviewee (Minor 'Ram' Hall) does not mention Bill Russell, nor does he confirm any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. No, I wasn't on those records at all. Yeah, I wanted it out then. No, never did it first. The only records I ever made was then was we made some for Columbia and Decker. Then Orysine with Good Time Jazz.

At that time, that very first one, 1921, Dink Johnson played clarinetti. That's right, yeah. He played little drums. He'd been with Freddie Keppard and his brother Bill. Did you ever play with Dink? A few, like little one nights, you know. When he played piano then, I guess?
Yeah, yeah. Because I played once with him at Son of Barber. He lived up there.
